About these 6 rides

They ride on 4 days of the week; Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday have the most, 2 each. The earliest start is Pedal Power Saturday Morning Ride at 9:00 am; the latest is Pedal Power Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride at 6:45 pm. After work, 3 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 3 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 4. There’s one ride made for families and 1 for young riders. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Nov 9, 2026.
